contract: Owned receiver reuses imported surface ID and the same Metal texture/buffer/queue/event through original/opposite/restored completed frames.20ms timeout followed by explicit signal per command, independent full-allocation comparison, then existing clean/abrupt exit/local-right cleanup.
limitations: Fixture generation indices are not native Canvas sequence fields. Both changed frames are generated in the receiver while sender waits for acknowledgement.
All pre-release statuses committed2; no hardware arrival or scheduling-delay separation.
Serial completed commands only; no concurrent writer/read overlap, command cancellation or automatic recovery.
Local resource-pointer tokens are measured inside owned helper and sanitized to equality counts; no private pointer dumps published.
Actual Canvas transport/completion policy, broader formats/storage modes, internal driver holders and final physical reclamation remain open.
No Xcode windows opened, user processes terminated or system protections changed.
